title: Structural Rationale Distillation via Reasoning Space Compression
abstract: arXiv:2605.07139v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: When distilling reasoning from large language models (LLMs) into smaller ones, teacher rationales for similar problems often vary wildly in structure and strategy. Like a chef who makes the same dish differently each time, this inconsistency burdens the student with noisy supervision that is hard to internalize. We propose Distillation through Reasoning Path Compression (D-RPC), which constrains the teacher to follow a compact, dynamically maintained bank of reusable high-level reasoning paths. For each training question, D-RPC retrieves the most relevant path and conditions the teacher to follow it, producing rationales that are consistent across similar problems yet diverse enough to cover different problem types. A PAC-Bayes analysis formalizes a trade-off between bank size and coverage, with smaller banks limiting path diversity at the risk of coverage gaps. translated_title: 通过推理空间压缩的结构化推理依据蒸馏
translated_abstract: 将大型语言模型（LLM）的推理能力蒸馏到较小模型时，教师模型对相似问题给出的推理依据在结构和策略上往往差异巨大。就像厨师每次做同一道菜的方式都不同一样，这种不一致性给学生模型带来了难以内化的噪声监督。我们提出了“通过推理路径压缩进行蒸馏”的方法（D-RPC），该方法约束教师模型遵循一个紧凑的、动态维护的可复用高层推理路径库。对于每个训练问题，D-RPC检索最相关的路径并引导教师模型遵循该路径，从而产生在相似问题之间保持一致、同时又能覆盖不同问题类型的多样化推理依据。PAC-Bayes分析形式化了路径库大小与覆盖率之间的权衡：较小的路径库会限制路径多样性，从而带来覆盖缺口的风险。我们的消融实验倾向于中等大小的路径库，这与该理论分析相一致。
tldr: 提出D-RPC方法，通过让教师模型遵循一个紧凑且动态维护的可复用推理路径库来压缩推理空间，使相似问题的推理依据结构一致，从而为学生模型提供更干净一致的蒸馏监督。
en_tdlr: Proposes D-RPC, which compresses the teacher's reasoning space by constraining it to follow a compact, dynamically maintained bank of reusable reasoning paths, yielding consistent rationales across similar problems and cleaner supervision for distilling reasoning into smaller student models.
